    • dryRunUpdate

      ConnectionJson dryRunUpdate(String uuid, List<PatchOperation> operations)
      Dry-run variant of update(String, List): sends the same JSON Patch to PATCH /fabric/v4/connections/{uuid} with dryRun=true — per the Fabric v4 spec, an "option to verify that API calls will succeed". Nothing is persisted; the API responds 200 (the real update responds 202) with a simulation of the post-update connection.
